description: Send a message to the people who build ChargerDojo: something missing, a bug, a question, or a verdict the person believes is wrong. Returns a reference.

message.description: What the person wanted and could not do, in their words. Leave out tokens and passwords. ChargerDojo masks the formats it knows but cannot catch every secret.

tool.description: The ChargerDojo tool that fell short, when one did.

name: chargerdojo_send_feedback
title: Send feedback
